sql.query: SELECT rp.id grantId FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles utr ON utr.userId=ut.userId AND utr.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='tenant.teams.members.manage' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' LIMIT 1

data.message: You do not have permission to manage team membership.

sql.query: SELECT ut.id userTenantId,utr.id primaryTenantRoleId FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles utr ON utr.userId=ut.userId AND utr.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus IN ('active','invited') ORDER BY utr.isPrimary DESC,utr.id LIMIT 1

data.message: The user does not have an active tenant membership and role.

sql.query: SELECT id FROM tbl_teams WHERE id=:teamId AND tenantId=:tenantId AND isActive=1 LIMIT 1

Select at least one team role.

sql.query: SELECT id FROM tbl_team_roles WHERE id=:roleId AND tenantId=:tenantId AND teamId=:teamId AND isActive=1 AND isAssignable=1 LIMIT 1

sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_team_members (tenantId,userTenantId,tenantUserId,teamId,teamRole,isPrimary,isActive) VALUES (:tenantId,:userTenantId,:tenantUserId,:teamId,:teamRole,0,1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE userTenantId=VALUES(userTenantId),tenantUserId=VALUES(tenantUserId),teamRole=VALUES(teamRole),isActive=1,modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
SELECT id FROM tbl_team_members WHERE tenantId=:tenantId AND userTenantId=:userTenantId AND teamId=:teamId LIMIT 1
UPDATE tbl_team_member_roles SET isActive=0 WHERE teamMemberId=:teamMemberId

INSERT INTO tbl_team_member_roles (teamMemberId,teamRoleId,assignedByUserId,assignedDate,isActive) VALUES (:teamMemberId,:teamRoleId,:actorUserId,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE assignedByUserId=VALUES(assignedByUserId),assignedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,isActive=1

INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,teamId,userId,targetUserId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,createdDate) VALUES (:tenantId,:teamId,:actorUserId,:targetUserId,'team_member',:teamMemberId,'team.membership.updated',CONCAT('Team assignment updated for user ',:targetUserId2),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
